notes: The two routes meet at محمد بن فضيل but then split: Abu Bakr's «قال أبو بكر عن أبي سنان» and Ibn al-Muthanna's «وقال ابن المثنى، عن ضرار بن مرة» name different next links, so each route is written in full and the tail is null
The text ends at a dangling «ح» with no matn, so the readings end where the names end
